serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
It seems like Big Daddy’s plan worked.
I don’t know exactly how he convinced the Admin to trust us, but he did a good job.
The way things turned out should make me happy, but…{{wi}} I can’t stop wondering about a few things.
Admin mentioned that I didn’t ‘prove myself’ by accomplishing any missions yet, but that’s not true, right?
I already delivered one backpack and the gun. That’s two missions.
Why would he lie like that though? What’s the point? 
He for sure knows that I’m reading all these posts and that I would witness his lies.
Is he so arrogant that he just doesn’t care? Does he think that people would follow his every wish no matter what he does or says?
Maybe it’s possible, but I doubt that’s the case. He seems like a very pragmatic man to me. If he did something like this, he did it for a reason.
Does he want to test my faith? That I won’t question him in any way?
Like Big Daddy said, he’s a master manipulator. The things he does may appear weird to me, but it might serve some purpose. 
He did something similar before when he posted about the assassination of that anti-sexbot activist.
Admin refused to admit his involvement in the whole thing, even after people in the comment section started doubting his words.
I wonder what will come of it. I will have a chance to ask him in person about these things, but I’m still thinking if it’s worth the risk.
The meeting will be in a public space so I should be relatively safe. After all, I only need to take a picture of him. That’s enough for Big Daddy, he will take care of the rest.
Now I only need to wait for Admin to send me the place and time of our meeting…
